items.headline: Falcons to start QB Michael Penix on Thursday vs. Packers
items.description: Quarterback Michael Penix Jr. will make his season debut this Thursday night when he starts against the Packers, the Falcons announced Monday.

items.headline: Packers WR Reed sustained back (not neck) injury, source says
items.description: Packers receiver Jayden Reed actually sustained a back injury -- and not a neck injury as originally thought -- in Sunday's game against the Jets and was expected to return to Green Bay on Monday, a sourced told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
